label: Immense: primitive unmeasured presence to all versus infinite cause of the being of all
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (immense conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is IMMENSE_1' use IMMENSE_1, the primitive Primitives.Immense (measured or contained by no place and present to everything that is). IMMENSE_2 (IsImmenseAsInfiniteCauseOfAll) types two grounds q.7 a.1 and q.8 a.3 give for it: g is INFINITE_1 and causes the being of everything else (tenselessly; q.8 a.3 gives causing being as the ground of presence by essence, and presence itself is not typed). IMMENSE_2 is a typed proxy for Aquinas's grounds, not a sense in which Dei Filius calls God immense. They differ in content, not only in strength: IMMENSE_1 concerns place, measure and presence in all three modes of q.8 a.3, IMMENSE_2 only infinity and causing being; neither is defined from the other and they are not identified. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever is IMMENSE_2 is IMMENSE_1'. Only an argument that lists it in sense_bridges passes from IMMENSE_2 to IMMENSE_1 (the routes nineGiveDeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensibleTyped and deiFiliusRootImmenseIncomprehensibleTyped); the controls of DeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensible show that without it a being with the nine can be IMMENSE_2 and not IMMENSE_1. Neither sense is INFINITE_2 (infinity of extent).
